signal: VitalEdge launched VitalEdge AI Labs and acquired Integrated Rental to expand its equipment-dealer platform

email.subject1: coverage on the AI Labs launch
email.body1:
Ross, saw VitalEdge launched AI Labs and acquired Integrated Rental to expand the dealer platform.

A launch plus an acquisition usually surfaces more accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VitalEdge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ross, quick follow-up for VitalEdge.

With new product and rental capabilities to cross-sell, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VitalEdge needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ross, last bit of proof for VitalEdge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VitalEdge's reply rate likely compares to other vertical software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ross, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch plus integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to VitalEdge either way.
